name: Keilan
text: Rope for the climbing wall arrived, but the fixing bolts are the wrong gauge, so hold off drilling the panels until the swap comes through. Keilan

name: Francioni
text: Choir risers are being moved to the side hall before the spring concert, so if you have a folder of sheet music stored under them, collect it this week and label the box with your part. Francioni

name: Albresa Jinghua
text: Garden group: the water butt by the greenhouse is leaking at the seam, so we have booked a repair for Thursday morning. Until then, fill your cans from the standpipe behind the shed and keep the tap closed overnight. The seed swap table runs on Saturday as planned, and the sign up sheet is in the bothy. Albresa Jinghua

name: Myvedete Fakhfouri
text: Studio booking for the podcast moved to Tuesday evening, so bring the foam panels down from the loft beforehand. Myvedete Fakhfouri

name: Bahrudin
text: Bike club ride on Sunday is now meeting at the allotment gates because the bridge path is flooded again. Bring a spare inner tube and check your brakes the night before, since the descent past the quarry is loose after the rain. Bahrudin

name: Roa
text: Tabletop group, the venue for the autumn tournament has changed to the community centre on Mill Road, so park in the school lot next door and use the side entrance by the kitchen. Doors open at nine, first round at ten sharp, and we need two more volunteers on the sign in desk for the morning slot. Roa

name: Erela Sheelamma
text: Life drawing class moved to room nine tonight, bring your own boards since the easels are still at the framers. Erela Sheelamma

name: Goguet Haile-Selassie
text: Sailing crew: the tide window on Saturday is tight, so be at the pontoon by half six to rig. The clubhouse kitchen is shut for rewiring, so pack your own flask and sandwiches. Goguet Haile-Selassie

name: Gjeme
text: Repair cafe this Saturday in the church hall, bring the broken lamps and the sewing machine that skips stitches. We still need a second person on the electrical bench and someone to run the tea urn. Tools are stored in the vestry cupboard, the key is with the warden, and the rota is on the noticeboard by the door. Gjeme

name: Schmöller
text: Greenhouse thermometer is reading three degrees high, so add the offset to the log until the replacement sensor arrives. Schmöller

name: Kazmierczyk Paltzer
text: Drama group: the costume store needs clearing before the panto build starts, so come with a car if you can and take a crate of hats back to the loft. Anything marked with a red tag goes to the charity shop instead. Kazmierczyk Paltzer

name: Aleksandar-Sasa Loenn
text: Woodwork bench: the thicknesser blades are back from sharpening, so the queue can restart on Monday. Check the fence alignment before the first pass, and sweep the shavings into the bin by the door, not the general waste. The dust extractor hose still leaks at the elbow, so tape it if you use the planer. Aleksandar-Sasa Loenn

name: Xuseen
text: Podiatry appointment Tuesday at 9:40 in the annex, bring the orthotic insoles and wear the loose trainers, and allow extra time for the parking barrier. Xuseen

name: Kugathas
text: Ultrasound scan for the kidney is Thursday at 2:20 in the imaging wing, so drink a litre of water an hour ahead and do not empty your bladder on the way in. Use the lift by the cafe, the stairs are closed for painting. Kugathas

name: Marianna Colqui
text: Annual review with the diabetes nurse is Wednesday at 11 in the health centre on Chapel Lane, second floor, room four. Bring the glucose diary, the medication boxes and the blood pressure readings from the monitor. The practice asked for the urine sample to be dropped at the lab before the appointment, so collect the pot from reception. Marianna Colqui

name: Shefike Mohan
text: Driving lesson moved to Sunday at 8, meet at the test centre car park and bring both parts of the licence. Shefike Mohan

name: Avzija
text: Flu walk in slots at the pharmacy start Thursday at ten, bring the vaccination record in a coat pocket and wear something with easy sleeve access. The queue usually moves quickly, but the pharmacist advised arriving before noon to miss the lunch rush. Avzija

name: Abgottspon
text: Dermatology follow up is Friday at 3:15 at the skin clinic opposite the station, bring the photos from the first visit and the list of creams you stopped using. The consultant wants a note from your gp about the antihistamines, so request that today if it is not on the system. Abgottspon

name: Suyi Ortler
text: Physio for the knee is Thursday at 4:30, bring the resistance band and the sheet of exercises from last time. Suyi Ortler

name: Mousse Zulene Abelheira
text: Boiler service is Tuesday between eight and twelve, so shift the bikes out of the hallway and clear the shelf under the worktop before the engineer rings. The landlord pays the invoice directly, so nothing is needed from you on the day. Mousse Zulene Abelheira

name: Türker
text: Retina screening is Monday at 1:40 in the mobile unit parked behind the leisure centre, take the referral letter and your current glasses. The drops blur your sight for a few hours, so arrange a lift home and bring sunglasses even if it is cloudy. Türker

name: Kollias
text: Swimming trial for the club squad is Saturday at 7:45, bring goggles, a cap and the completed medical form. Kollias

name: Lalie Nurjeta
text: Cervical screening moved to Wednesday at 4:10 at the women's clinic on Park Street, the entrance is around the back by the pharmacy. Bring the invitation letter if you still have it, otherwise the desk can look you up by date of birth. Lalie Nurjeta

name: Hope Miller
text: Podiatry surgery for the ingrown nail is Thursday at 11:30, the clinic has moved to the ground floor suite next to the hearing centre. Take the antibiotic list and wear open shoes afterwards, the toe stays tender for a day or two, so book the taxi home in advance. Hope Miller

name: Jannike
text:
Lab coats are back from the laundry, the box is on the shelf by the autoclave. Please take only your size, the spares are running low.
Thanks,
Jannike

name: Fouassier
text:
Kiln is down to two working elements, so keep the bisque shelves to the left side and let me know before you fire a glaze load this week.
Best regards,
Fouassier

name: da Graça Cellik
text:
Roof rack fittings turned up at last, so the long boards can go on the estate car from tomorrow. The straps are in the boot, and I have put the torque wrench in the glovebox so the bolts get nipped to spec at the layby before the motorway stretch.
Cheers,
da Graça Cellik

name: Et Tazi-Tazi
text:
Spare keys for the kiln room are back on the hook, only three sets left so sign the sheet when you borrow one.
Thanks,
Et Tazi-Tazi

name: Oriano
text:
First aid kit in the van has been restocked, the old dressings that were past their date are in the bin by the sink. Check the burns gel before the weekend trip, the tube looked split on the last check.
Regards,
Oriano

name: Tinet
text:
Hedge trimmer and the long ladders are back in the lock up after the weekend, please log them in the shed book as returned. The strimmer needs a new spool, I have left a note taped to the charge station so whoever buys the next order picks one up.
Thanks,
Tinet

name: Trowbridge Déchelette Drake
text:
Stage lights for the spring show are booked, the invoice went to the treasurer this morning for approval.
Thanks,
Trowbridge Déchelette Drake

name: Bugayong Kiamouche Frigola
text:
Band practice moves to the scout hut on Tuesday, the church hall is being rewired for the week. Bring the long stands and the music folders, the new drummer is joining us for the second half.
Thanks,
Bugayong Kiamouche Frigola

name: Orijana
text:
Rowan and the other beekeepers checked the hives after the storm, all three colonies are fine and the straps held. The new queen in the blue hive is laying well, so we can still take a small crop in August if the weather holds. Please bring the spare veil on Sunday, mine has a split at the seam.
Best,
Orijana

name: Bernardinello
text:
Van has a slow puncture, so swap it with the estate for the Wednesday deliveries and keep the receipts for the fuel.
Thanks,
Bernardinello

name: Kiani Stracquadanio
text:
Signed copies of the programme are in the office safe, two boxes that need counting before the gala. The printer is sending a replacement roll of the gold card on Thursday, so wait for that before wrapping any more.
Thanks,
Kiani Stracquadanio

name: Ricards Priscille
text:
Tables for the quiz night are nearly full, we have one left by the window if anyone wants it. Raffle prizes can go in the crate behind the bar, label them with the donor so the compare can thank people on the night. Doors open at seven, questions start at eight.
Cheers,
Ricards Priscille

name: Kumbar
text:
Cold store door seal is being replaced on Friday, so move the pallets of juice to the dry aisle before then.
Regards,
Kumbar

name: Rawiya
text:
Chiropody visit for the heel is Wednesday at 2, the clinic is the one by the bus station with the green awning. Take the insoles out of the walking boots and bring them in a bag, and wear the sandals home.
Thanks,
Rawiya

name: Tsutsui
text:
Colonoscopy prep starts Tuesday evening, the two sachets from the pharmacy go in the fridge until then. No solid food after lunch on the day before, clear drinks only, and stop the iron tablets now as the letter says. The unit rings on Monday to confirm the arrival time, so keep the phone handy.
Kind regards,
Tsutsui

name: Xuseen Bilsel
text:
Manicure appointment Friday at 5:30 at the salon on Bridge Street, bring the voucher from the hen weekend.
Thanks,
Xuseen Bilsel

name: de Jesus
text:
Audiology appointment for the left hearing aid is Thursday at 9:10, the room is behind reception past the pharmacy counter. Take the spare batteries and the little brush, the audiologist will retube the mould while you wait.
Regards,
de Jesus

name: Xhem
text:
Physio session for the ankle is Monday at 8:20 in the sports clinic above the pool. Bring the wobble board if you still have it, the exercises were set around it, and wear shorts so the tape can go on easily. The therapist asked for the mri report to be uploaded before the visit.
Thanks,
Xhem

name: Potkonjak
text:
Osteopath visit for the back is Tuesday at 4, bring the xray envelope from the hospital and wear the flat shoes.
Thanks,
Potkonjak

name: Chiel Zeru Cohendet
text:
Speech therapy for the youngest is Wednesday at 3:30 at the children's centre by the library, take the home book to show the new exercises. Parking is on the street, so allow a few minutes to find a spot.
Best,
Chiel Zeru Cohendet

name: Tshering Spyros Ibeh
text:
Orthodontist appointment for the brace tighten moved to Friday at 11:40, take the appointment card and the elastics box. Avoid the usual crunchy snacks for a day after, and rinse with the salt solution if the wire rubs. The practice said to arrive ten minutes early for the covid questions.
Thanks,
Tshering Spyros Ibeh

name: Heinzpeter
text:
Dentist check for the filling is Monday at 4:20, take the mouthguard from the bedside drawer and the list of painkillers.
Thanks,
Heinzpeter

name: Sauveur
text:
Varicose vein consultation is Thursday at 1:50 at the vascular unit on the hospital ring road, check in at the desk on the left. Wear loose trousers and skip the long soak the night before.
Regards,
Sauveur

name: Khashayar Votim
text:
Nursery settling in session for the little one is Tuesday at 9:30, take the spare clothes and the comforter. Stay in the parents room for the first hour, the staff will wave you in when the snack round starts. The key worker asked for the allergy form to be filled in before the visit.
Thanks,
Khashayar Votim

name: Coduroglu Leliebre
text:
Weigh in for the slimming group is Tuesday at 6:30, take the card and come in the light clothes from last time.
Thanks,
Coduroglu Leliebre

name: Mazzetta
text:
Nebuliser service at the clinic is Friday at noon, take the machine and the mask so the technician can check the flow. The appointment card needs the sticker from the last repair.
Regards,
Mazzetta
